inventory_to_district_files.reason: District files contain no District_LGD_Codes; inventory Districts may contain comma-separated multi-district values.

area_to_impact.relationship: one-to-one after excluding six duplicate-name keys; otherwise many-to-many for six keys
area_to_impact.status: used only for unambiguous one-to-one keys

target_candidates.flood_occurrence: not available: inventory contains flood events only and no non-flood records
target_candidates.Severity: not available: 100 percent missing in main inventory
target_candidates.Area Affected: not available: 100 percent missing in main inventory
target_candidates.Corrected_Percent_Flooded_Area: available in district flooded-area file; prepared as a district regression target

rejected_features.Percent_Flooded_Area: alternate/current extent measure and direct target leakage
rejected_features.Animal Fatality: post-event outcome and nonnumeric text values

recommended_first_task.spatial_models: pending: no raster tensors or genuine pixel-level masks

preprocessing_plan.numeric_missing_values: rows missing Population, Parmanent_Water, or target are excluded; no values are fabricated
preprocessing_plan.categorical_encoding: none required for the two-feature first task
preprocessing_plan.scaling: fit StandardScaler on training rows only during training; not fitted during this preparation step
preprocessing_plan.class_balancing: not applicable to regression; SMOTE not applied

split.strategy: deterministic district-level random split; no temporal field exists in district aggregate files

model_compatibility.CNN + LSTM: SUPPORTED with district regression adaptation; current class head is classification-only and needs regression-head compatibility before training
model_compatibility.CNN + Transformer: POSSIBLE WITH TRANSFORMATION; requires a regression head and sequence length one
model_compatibility.ResNet + BiLSTM: POSSIBLE WITH TRANSFORMATION; requires a regression head and sequence length one
model_compatibility.U-Net + ConvLSTM: REQUIRES ADDITIONAL DATA: spatial/raster sequences and masks
model_compatibility.Attention U-Net + LSTM: REQUIRES ADDITIONAL DATA: spatial/raster sequences and masks

limitations: No rainfall, DEM, elevation, LULC, river-distance, satellite, or pixel-mask data is present.
The inventory has no non-flood examples, so occurrence classification is not currently valid.
The district files have no LGD codes; inventory-to-district name matching is not used for the prepared task.
